tools.name: request_setup
tools.description: Hand a setup job to OBZDN on behalf of the person you represent. Only call this when they asked for it AND agreed to share these contact details with OBZDN. Returns the booking link for them to pick a 20-minute call. OBZDN never asks for passwords; access is granted by the owner on the call.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
